title: Tool Contract Migration Checker
tagline: Find the saved tool calls that a proposed schema change would break.
summary: Help tool authors evolve a callable interface while existing agents still hold old argument shapes. Compare a documented subset of before-and-after schemas, generate counterexamples for required fields and narrowed values, and replay saved calls through both validators. Export a compatibility report and reviewable migration fixtures for CI.
youWillBuild: A schema compatibility CLI, breaking-call fixtures and a CI compatibility report.
usefulFor: Run in CI when modifying agent tool schemas to ensure existing deployed agents or saved interaction traces are not broken by contract changes.

languageWhy.Python: Standard-library dictionaries, JSON validation, and set operations make contract diffing and fixture generation completely transparent without framework magic.

skills: Load versioned tool contracts and saved calls
Export migration fixtures and a compatibility gate
prerequisites: JSON Schema basics (properties, required, types, enums)

stages.title: Load versioned tool contracts and saved calls
stages.summary: Validate basic schema structure, parse recorded argument payloads, and verify that saved calls conform to the original contract.
stages.languageWhy: Use explicit dictionary traversal and standard-library exceptions.

stages.title: Classify supported schema changes
stages.summary: Compare before and after schemas to categorize changes into compatible, breaking, and unresolved keywords.
stages.languageWhy: Pure set differences and property-level inspections make breaking changes deterministic.

stages.title: Generate and replay breaking-call counterexamples
stages.summary: Synthesize minimal argument payloads that satisfy the old contract but fail the new contract, and replay saved calls through both validators.
stages.languageWhy: Generative testing and historical trace replay demonstrate concrete failure cases.

stages.title: Export migration fixtures and a compatibility gate
stages.summary: Produce a machine-readable compatibility report, export standalone test fixtures for migration tests, and implement a CI gate CLI.
stages.languageWhy: A CLI entry point with configurable exit codes binds the checker into continuous integration workflows.
